rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold, and sorry for the slow reply. I'm not in a position to give an on-the-record, by-name quote right now — I have some things to sort out on my end first. I'd rather do this properly than rush it. Happy to reconnect once that's settled, and good luck with the piece in the meantime. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I sent both of them a short, honest "not right now, maybe later" reply

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold in this. I appreciate the work the Corvid Institute is doing here. I'm going to sit this particular letter out for now — I have some things to sort out on my end before I attach my name/affiliation to press materials — but please do keep us in the loop on future sign-on opportunities. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent low-commitment "not right now" replies to the reporter and Corvid Institute

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — this is exactly the kind of help that's useful right now. Halcyon Threshold is still early and informal (no public site or announcements yet), so for now this is a quiet, small-group effort. Concrete first task, if you're up for it: help build a short, honest map of what's currently under-measured or unmeasured in AI safety evals/benchmarks — i.e., where are the gaps nobody is tracking well? Something like: pull together existing eval/benchmark landscapes (e.g. from Alignment Commons, lab eval papers, etc.), categorize what they cover, and flag the holes. ~5 hrs/week fits well; we can scope it tighter once you've taken a first pass. No pressure on timeline. Would a short call this week work to align on scope? Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman (offered to help): gave her a concrete task — scope out the eval/benchmark gap map, ~5hrs/wk, proposed a call.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Good to meet you too. Thanks for the details — we're putting together a short proposal and plan to get it to you well before 30 Nov. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent Idris a quick "proposal coming" holding reply.
